subject: Human Body
title: Hormones vs Nerves
description: A fast breakdown of Hormones vs Nerves for builders.

hook.text: Touch a hot stove and your hand jerks back in milliseconds. But hunger builds over hours. Two systems, two speeds.

buildup.text: The nervous system sends fast electrical signals for immediate responses.

discovery.text: Nerves target specific muscles or organs.

climax.text: Nerves handle urgency. Hormones handle duration. Together they regulate everything from reflexes to puberty.

punchline.text: Nerves react fast. Hormones last long. Both are essential.

quiz.question: What connects the nervous and endocrine systems?
options: The hypothalamus, which functions as both
The adrenal glands sending nerve signals
